title: Slot Picker
description: Booking time picker: mini-month on the left, available times on the right, viewer-timezone selector. Loads UTC slots from slots_url and writes the chosen slot's UTC start into a hidden field. Universal HTML5 + vanilla JS.

fields.name: slots_url
fields.label: Slots URL (JSON)
fields.help: Endpoint returning {slots:[{start,end}]} (UTC) for a start/end range

fields.name: field_name
fields.label: Hidden Field Name
fields.help: Name of the hidden input that receives the chosen UTC slot start
